info.name: Atlassian Admin Account Issue Priorities API

items.docs:
Changes the order of issue priorities.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

params.name: startAt
params.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

params.name: id
params.description: The list of priority IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `id=2&id=3`.

params.name: projectId
params.description: The list of projects IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `projectId=10010&projectId=10111`.

params.name: priorityName
params.description: The name of priority to search for.

params.name: onlyDefault
params.description: Whether only the default priority is returned.

items.docs:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of priorities. The list can contain all priorities or a subset determined by any combination of these criteria:

* a list of priority IDs. Any invalid priority IDs are ignored.
* a list of project IDs. Only priorities that are available in these projects will be returned. Any invalid project IDs are ignored.
